nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Sustainable agriculture|Crop rotation systems_qna_000
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What were the two crop rotation systems used in the modeling?
nodes.answer: The two crop rotation systems used in the modeling were 500 hectares each, with one included in the LCA, dedicated to the cultivation of spring barley with under-sown cover crops (rotation 1).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Sustainable agriculture|Crop rotation systems_qna_001
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What types of cropping systems were evaluated in the study?
nodes.answer: The evaluated cropping systems included a low-diversified rotation of lentil-wheat-lentil-wheat, a moderately diversified rotation of pea-wheat-lentil-wheat, a highly diversified rotation of pea-mustard-lentil-wheat, and a wheat monocrop control.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Sustainable agriculture|Crop rotation systems_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How long did the crop rotation study last, and when was it conducted?
nodes.answer: The crop rotation study lasted 8 years and was conducted from 2010 to 2017.
